title: Pure Voiceless Voice
summary: Pure Voiceless Voice LIGHT Ritual strategy, centered on Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice and her holy draconic protectors. The deck maintains unbreakable targeting protection while Skull Guardian sits at 4100 ATK with omni-negation, continually recurring Lo from the graveyard on every Ritual arrival.

summary.title: Starters
points: Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice places a Voiceless Voice Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap (such as Barrier or Radiance) directly from your Deck face-up on summon, counts as the entire Tribute for any LIGHT Ritual Summon, and revives itself from the GY whenever a LIGHT Ritual monster is Special Summoned.

Barrier of the Voiceless Voice adds any Voiceless Voice card from your Deck to your hand on activation, and prevents the opponent from targeting your LIGHT monsters with attacks or card effects while you control Lo and a LIGHT Ritual Monster.

Saffira, Dragon Queen of the Voiceless Voice discards itself to send a Ritual Spell from Deck to GY and search a LIGHT Warrior or Dragon Ritual Monster from your Deck, then banishes itself from GY to Ritual Summon a LIGHT Ritual Monster from your hand by tributing monsters.

Sauravis, Dragon Sage of the Voiceless Voice Special Summons itself by shuffling 2 Spells from hand or GY into the Deck, and tributes itself during the opponent's turn to Special Summon Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended or Skull Guardian directly from your hand or Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Lo, the Prayers + Saffira
steps: Normal Summon Lo, the Prayers of the Voiceless Voice; Lo triggers on summon to place Barrier of the Voiceless Voice face-up from your Deck.
Activate Barrier's effect to add Saffira, Dragon Queen of the Voiceless Voice from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Saffira in hand, discarding itself to send Prayers of the Voiceless Voice from Deck to GY and add Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice to your hand.
Activate Saffira's GY effect, banishing itself to Ritual Summon Skull Guardian by tributing Lo on the field.
Trigger both Skull Guardian and Lo simultaneously: Skull Guardian searches Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended (or Radiance of the Voiceless Voice), and Lo Special Summons itself back to the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Skull Guardian, Protector of the Voiceless Voice gains 2050 ATK while Lo is on the field or in the GY (reaching 4100 ATK), searches a Voiceless Voice monster or LIGHT Ritual Monster upon summon, and negates the activation of any Spell, Trap, or monster effect as a Quick Effect while you control Lo.
Sauravis, the Ancient and Ascended acts as a handtrap to negate a card or effect that targets a monster you control by discarding itself, and bounces itself on field to negate a Special Summon.
Saffira, Divine Dragon of the Voiceless Voice draws 2 cards and discards 1 card upon Ritual Summon if you control Lo, and randomly discards 1 card from the opponent's hand during battle.
Radiance of the Voiceless Voice targets and destroys cards your opponent controls up to the number of Ritual Monsters you control, or recovers a Voiceless Voice card from GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Prayers of the Voiceless Voice Ritual Summons any LIGHT Ritual Monster by tributing LIGHT monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Ritual Monster's Level, and Special Summons a LIGHT Ritual Monster from Deck if a face-up LIGHT Ritual Monster you control leaves the field.
Blessing of the Voiceless Voice recovers a Voiceless Voice card from GY to hand, and can perform a Ritual Summon whenever a non-Ritual monster is Normal or Special Summoned.
Guardian of the Voiceless Voice is a Continuous Trap that Special Summons Skull Guardian directly from your hand or Deck if an opponent monster is destroyed or leaves the field.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Diviner of the Herald, Dogmatika, and Branded engines are left out of this build to focus entirely on a pure, consistent Voiceless Voice engine that maximizes in-archetype protections and recoveries.
